comment: Left tab strip (Equipment / Thrown Weapons, Poison / Paralysis / Elixir): 20x50 one-glyph-per-line boxes drawn over the portrait. Make them a horizontal label to the right of the tab icon (icon sprite spans button-centre +-60). XUnity's AutoResize(14,32) on the Buttons parent wins over our size, so cap the size through the box height (30 -> ~24px, matching the item buttons below).

Item name over the level bar: 300x79 at 40px wrapped 'Tang Clan Small Sword' onto the Level row. Use the full width of the gradient back (1023-1406) and best-fit 22-36; height 56 so a 2-line fallback only happens at <=26px and stays above the Level row (y 251).
'Level' label left of the bar was 47px wide and wrapped to 'Lev'. Let it overflow (bar starts 48px to the right, text is ~54px) and nudge it 8px left so it does not touch the bar frame.
'Insufficient points\n' has a trailing newline and got flagged V-CLIPPED; allow vertical overflow so longer next-level messages are never cut.

'Maximum Spend:' / 'Cost:' (StringTable: 'Maximum consumption:', 'Spending silver dollars:') in 153x36 boxes wrapped and ran into the value. Widen to 178 and best-fit 13-19 on one line (height 30 forbids a 2nd line).
Move the '8/8' and '50' values right of the widened labels (label ends at x=1706).
Item description (369x265, 22px, Truncate): the sword text already fills all 9 lines; best-fit 16-22 so longer descriptions shrink instead of losing their last line.

CombatDesc/BattleDesc/MiscDesc Title/Top and Title/Down are '[' and ']' glyphs rotated -91 that capped the two-hanzi vertical title. With a horizontal English title they are stray brackets; hide them if the game ever enables them.
Section titles (Duel / Battle / Misc): 100x111 box sized for two stacked hanzi. Make it a single horizontal line so the Info text 38px below never collides with a wrapped title.
Section header between the two rule lines ('Equipment', 'Hidden Weapon', 'Alchemy'): 80x50 box clipped to 'Equi'/'Alche'. Widen to 180 with best-fit 18-28 on one line.
Right-hand rule line starts after the widened header (header spans x 613-793).
Current item name: 30x200 vertical column drawn over the big item icon. Put it horizontally above the diamond frame (frame top ~y 632), centred on the frame (x 360), best-fit 16-25.
Develop cards (paper tilted 11 deg): shrink the 180px icon to 140 and move it up-right so a name line fits along the paper's bottom inner border.

Card item name: 30x166 column rotated 11 deg along the paper's left margin ('Ta/ng/Cl/an/...'). Keep the 11 deg tilt but make it a 195x40 line along the bottom of the inner border (pivot moved to paper-frame (-5,16)); best-fit 13-15, up to 2 lines. Lock/Name shows '???'.
Locked cards show '???' - allow the original 28px there.

'Requirement: Level 10' (179px at 16pt via develop-card-require-text) belongs on the develop card's bottom margin strip, between the inner frame and the torn edge of pic_dev_paper_1. The old dx -46 started it 46px left of the prefab x (101.3 -> 55): 'Requ' hung off the paper's left edge and, the line being tilted 11 degrees with the paper, the rest rode up onto the frame line (review_upgrade_r1dev_story_weapon.png). The prefab x already starts inside the strip and the 205px Level box ends inside the paper (about x281 of the 360 card); raised 4px to centre the text band in the strip. Checked on an offline mockup with the real sprite, calibrated against that capture.

'Developed' inside the red seal stamp (37x83 vertical sprite): the 34x69 box stacked one glyph per line. Read it sideways top-to-bottom along the stamp instead (local -90 on top of the seal's 12 deg).

Condition list: rows are 50px tall but 'Equipment Level 5' wrapped to two lines in a 200px box, so its 2nd line sat next to the next checkbox. Shift the column 40px left (gradient back starts at x 470) and widen the text to 270 on a single line.
Develop target name (450x50, 32-40px): long names would wrap and truncate; best-fit 20-36 on one line.
'Long press to develop' hint under the mouse icon: centre it under the icon (icon centre x 1026) and drop it 12px so it clears the icon.

Refund info (shown when a development is affordable): three 300x47 rows 31px apart; the English header and 'Return N points of forging points' wrapped and clipped. Move the block left (clear of the description column at x 1240) so rows can be 400 wide, one line each.
